peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.9% below its local comparables; 55 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (70.9): 3.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 285 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,765,000 ($2,515 psf, 1,087–1,194 sq ft; 10 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,494 psf (range $2,140–3,122); 0.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $23,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $4,905,000 ($2,337 psf, 2,098 sq ft; 6 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,562 psf (range $2,073–3,450); 8.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $472,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 220 m, Novena MRT about 690 m; closer than 475 of 551 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Primary) about 590 m; more than 493 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 250 m), more than 212 of 551 similar developments (the same as 62); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 330 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,340 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 240 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 290 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,310 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,420 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,470 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,500 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,590 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,830 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 477 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 64 new sales and 1,146 resales (1,210 purchases); new sales were 5.3% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 350 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 530 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,280 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,470 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,490 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,146 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 400 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,146 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,167 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−1.8%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
